title: Verify successful login with valid credentials
description: User can sign in with a registered email and password.
steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter valid email
3. Enter valid password
4. Click Sign In
expected: User is redirected to the dashboard.

title: Verify error on invalid password
description: Login is rejected when the password is wrong.
steps:
1. Open login page
2. Enter valid email
3. Enter wrong password
4. Click Sign In

title: Verify project can be created
description: A signed-in user can create a new project.
steps:
1. Go to Projects
2. Click Create Project
3. Fill name + description
4. Submit
expected: The new project card appears in the grid.

title: Verify dashboard pass rate updates
description: Marking results updates the dashboard pass-rate KPI.
steps:
1. Create a run
2. Mark a case PASS
3. Open the dashboard
expected: Pass-rate percentage reflects the new result.
